title: Dream Clean homepage direction
question: Choose a direction for homeowners and property clients; each supports a quote form and calling.

options.label: The Open House
options.thesis: A carefully prepared property opens into a clear invitation to inquire.
options.viewport: Dream Clean above an expansive interior photograph; residential and property cleaning routes lead to a numbered quote questionnaire.
options.risk: Could resemble a property listing unless cleaning and contact remain explicit.

raised.raise: One photographic focal moment owns the opening viewport.
Unequal sections pace the path from property to inquiry.
Every service and inquiry destination is directly addressable.
Motion settles and pauses rather than competing with the content.
The selected service keeps its context visible through the questionnaire.

options.label: The Welcome Book
options.thesis: A personal local introduction connects housekeeping with homes ready for their next occupants.
options.viewport: A broad book-like spread pairs Dream Clean’s introduction with a property photograph and a clear Request a quote action.
options.risk: Warm hospitality styling is familiar; avoid implying property management or hosting services.

options.label: Homes, Pieced Together
options.thesis: Photos and real customer words form a domestic patchwork of homes and property care.
options.viewport: An unequal photographic patchwork surrounds a calm cleaning introduction, then resolves into a plain numbered questionnaire.
options.case: Strong domestic identification; less immediate clarity for commercial property clients.
options.risk: Textile texture can crowd evidence and must stay away from form controls.

options.label: Indoor Weather
options.thesis: A single room fills the opening with amber light.
options.viewport: A single room fills the opening with amber light.
options.case: Loses audience identification and cleaning clarity to the property brochure.

options.label: Manga Page
options.thesis: Cleaning information unfolds in asymmetrical sequential panels.
options.viewport: Cleaning information unfolds in asymmetrical sequential panels.
options.risk: Comic narration distracts both client groups.
options.case: Loses audience identification and cleaning clarity to the property brochure.

options.label: Teletext
options.thesis: Cleaning services and contact are addressed as numbered broadcast pages.
options.viewport: Cleaning services and contact are addressed as numbered broadcast pages.
options.case: Loses audience identification and cleaning clarity to the property brochure.

options.label: Ink Basin
options.thesis: A fluid surface settles beside a still service and quote margin.
options.viewport: A fluid surface settles beside a still service and quote margin.
options.risk: Simulation competes with real business evidence.
options.case: Loses audience identification and cleaning clarity to the property brochure.

options.label: Event Display
options.thesis: Service types radiate toward a central inquiry with contextual details.
options.viewport: Service types radiate toward a central inquiry with contextual details.
options.risk: Scientific notation makes household cleaning harder to understand.
options.case: Loses audience identification and cleaning clarity to the property brochure.
options.kept: Visible context for the selected service.

canonCard.label: The familiar cleaning homepage
canonCard.thesis: A conventional service website with a clean-room hero, service sections, reviews, and quote form.
canonCard.viewport: Logo and navigation above a split headline/photo hero with Request a quote and phone actions.
canonCard.risk: Easy to recognize, but visually similar to other cleaning companies.
